name: Moroccan Barber Johannesburg
lead: Walk-in haircuts, hot towel shaves and gentlemen's facials in Randburg, where comfort meets style and grooming becomes an experience.

experience.title: The Moroccan Barber experience
experience.text: Step in and you're transported to a world where your appearance is the top priority. Signature hot towel shaves, contemporary styling and luxurious gentlemen's facials, all without compromising on time or quality. And a great coffee while you wait.

items: Scissor cut, flat top or fade

currency_note: Walk-ins welcome. Cash, debit and credit cards accepted.

special.title: Your VIP grooming experience
special.text: Celebrate your wedding day with an exclusive package for grooms and groomsmen. The groom enjoys a complimentary VIP service: haircut, shave or beard groom, and a full facial. Relax with drinks and shisha, and create lasting memories with a private photoshoot.
